groups.name: owner_identity

groups.name: peer_to_index_and_secondary_storage
groups.base_provenance: 0x631182 loads same owner global. count +16390, peer IDs +16398 and stride 32 select index +163AC. The resulting index addresses a different subsystem at global 0x3326AE0 +0xC4A0 + index*24; its capacity is not proven here.

groups.name: index_to_separate_slot_mapping
groups.base_provenance: Tag 0xE5 object in R10 is independent from client. Global owner lookup supplies network index; that index selects a dword at object+0x27D8 + index*4. The selected value must be <4 before object+0x620E8 + selected*0x1EE18 goes to 0x1893D40. This does NOT prove network index equals gameplay roster ordinal.

groups.name: local_network_index_less_than_four_gate
groups.base_provenance: Same owner global in R8; compares confirmed peer ID with owner+0xB398 (local ID), then directly rejects index>=4 from a special path. This is an unsigned network-index bound, distinct from occupancy or roster count.

groups.name: inline_reverse_lookup
groups.base_provenance: Same global owner; EBP<4 path searches index +163AC, and returns low 32 bits of peer-ID field +16398 through ECX/EDX. For EBP>=4 this lookup is skipped. Meaning of EBP and consuming subsystem are not established here.

groups.name: record_pointer_escape_uses_flag
groups.base_provenance: 0x1083150 receives embedded client via owner update. Direct calls establish leaf 0x1084FD0 entry; both returned record-pointer consumers use byte +0x18, not index +0x14.
